findings.title: Harvests on the To date are left out of the stats (range end is exclusive)
findings.expected: A 777 g harvest logged on 2026-03-17 is counted when From = To = 2026-03-17 (the To date is included)
findings.actual: API returns harvest_count 0 and total_grams 0, and the page says '0 harvests from 17 Mar 2026 to 17 Mar 2026' and 'No harvests in this range'. The query uses harvested_on < to, so the To date is dropped. The dashboard's best plant this year uses the same helper and also leaves out 31 Dec.

findings.title: A hung stats request leaves the page on 'Loading stats…' forever, still showing the old range's table
findings.expected: After 13 s with no answer, a timeout or error message and a way to try again; old results not shown as if they belonged to the new range
findings.actual: 'Loading stats…' stays on screen with no timeout, while the table and Best plants still show the 1 Jan to 31 Dec 2026 data even though From now says 2026-03-01
